reviews.text:
Building a new in-ground pool and spa is a big decision! We started by getting quotes from 5 different pool companies, and the choice became clear when we met with TX Pool and Construction. They stood head and shoulders above the rest thanks to their unmatched transparency and clear communication from the very first consultation.
The project success is all thanks to the incredible team! We especially want to praise Armando (Owner) and Uriel (Construction Manager). They were consummate professionals, always keeping us informed, paying rigorous attention to every detail, and being highly accommodating of the changes we requested along the way.
The final result is stunning—a perfect pool and spa that transformed our home!
If you're starting your pool journey, whether for new construction or remodeling, we enthusiastically recommend you consult with TX Pool and Construction. You won't regret it!
reviews.author: Animesh Prabhakar

reviews.text: I recently had the pleasure of working with Tx Pool & Construction for pool updates at Spring Valley Apartments, and I couldn't be happier with the results! From start to finish, their team was professional, efficient, and attentive to detail. They transformed our pool area into a beautiful oasis that our residents absolutely love. Communication throughout the project was excellent; they kept us informed at every step and were always available to address any questions or concerns. The project was completed on time and within budget, which is always a plus! I highly recommend Tx Pool & Construction for any pool renovation or construction needs. Their expertise and dedication to quality work make them a standout choice! Thank you, Tx Pool & Construction, for an amazing job at Spring Valley Apartments!
reviews.author: Mauricio Dominguez

reviews.text: We enjoyed working with TX Pool & Construction!  Armando, Uriel and Stephanie were very attentive to our needs and treated us like family.  The quality of their craftsmanship was excellent and while they weren't the cheapest quote we received, we don't regret using them at all.  In fact, we highly recommend them!
reviews.author: Channda Douglas

reviews.text: We are OBSESSED with the outcome of our backyard! Never in a million years did I think our tiny backyard space was capable of this beautiful oasis. Thank you Armando & Uriel for your great communication and dedication to completing our project. This is easily everyone’s favorite area of our home. ☀️🍉🕶
reviews.author: Isabel Aguado

reviews.text: They are so responsible and professional. They worry about everything like if it was their own home. I love it very well done 👌 Would pick this company again for any pool remodeling! Thank you for making my wife’s and I dream pool 😌
reviews.author: Khaled Nafal

reviews.text: TX Pool & Construction has made it a great experience designing and building our pool!  We’ve had it for about a year at this point and they are still always responsive and helpful with any questions we’ve had.
reviews.author: Thomas Russell

reviews.text: We highly recommend this company. They over delivered every step of the way. The construction was without issue.  We have a very small backyard and they were able to design the best pool for our space.  The people are absolutely amazing. Their communication was incredible. We spoke with other neighbors that had a very different experience and we are just so grateful. We have recommended them over and over to our neighbors and friends.
reviews.author: Crystal Steele

reviews.text: I cannot say enough about this company.  I suddenly and unexpectedly lost my husband during our pool building process.  Armando and Uriel went above and beyond to take care of me and the kids and make sure we were beyond happy with our finished product.  It’s been 6 months since completion and they still continue to check in on us and make sure we are happy with the pool.  This isn’t a big chain pool building company-it’s about the people and it shows.  Thank you for everything, from the bottom of our hearts.
reviews.author: Lauren Ludlow
